Bill Ackman has launched a combined IPO for Pershing Square USA, Ltd. (PSUS), a new $5-$10 billion closed-end fund, and Pershing Square Inc. (PSI), the management firm, with pricing set for April 28, 2026. PSUS shares are priced at $50 each, with investors receiving one PSI share for every five PSUS shares purchased. Key Details of the PSUS IPO: Structure: A combined offering of PSUS (closed-end fund) and PSI (asset manager). Listing: Both will be listed on the New York Stock Exchange under tickers "PSUS" and "PS," respectively. Goal: The IPO seeks to raise between $5 billion and $10 billion. Bonus Shares: For every 100 PSUS shares purchased in the IPO, investors receive 20 PSI shares at no additional cost. Investment Focus: PSUS aims to invest in 12 to 15 large-cap, "undervalued" North American companies with strong, durable growth. Background: The roadshow began in April 2026, aimed at providing permanent capital to manage a portfolio similar to Ackman’s existing hedge fund. The combined offering includes a $2.8 billion private placement, and the final completion is subject to market conditions.
